label: US launch
detail: A one-off 2014 i8 Concours d'Elegance Edition sold for $825,000 at Gooding's Pebble Beach auction, the world record for an i8 and about six times the $135,700 MSRP. It is a charity one-off, so it is not plotted.

label: 2018 facelift
detail: The i8 skipped the 2018 model year in the US. The facelifted 2019 car added the roadster, 12 more hp (369 total) and electric range up from 15 to 18 miles. Date shown is the year only.

label: End of production
detail: Production ended in 2020 after 20,465 cars. Date shown is the year only. The 2020 yearly median rests on just 4 sales.

label: Used-car boom peaks
detail: Industry-wide used prices (Manheim index) ran up from mid-2020 and peaked in Dec 2021 and Jan 2022 at 257.7, then fell 15% through Dec 2022. i8 yearly medians were highest in 2021 and 2022, then slid.

label: Cayman GTS US pricing
detail: 981 Cayman GTS (340 hp) priced from $75,200 with 6-speed manual, $79,160 with PDK; deliveries followed the reveal.

label: 718 Cayman replaces 981
detail: 718 Cayman revealed at Beijing with turbo flat-fours, ending the naturally aspirated flat-six Cayman GTS after MY2016.

label: Used-car price peak
detail: Manheim Used Vehicle Value Index peaked at 257.7 in Dec 2021–Jan 2022.

label: $83.5k 2015 GTS manual
detail: 14k-mile 2015 Cayman GTS 6-speed sold for $83,500 on PCARMARKET near the post-boom high.

label: $84k 2016 GTS
detail: 10k-mile 2016 Cayman GTS sold for $84,000 on Bring a Trailer, the highest sale in this dataset.

label: G550 4x4² US pricing
detail: Mercedes priced the US-market G550 4x4² from $225,925 for arrival in early 2017, above the V12 AMG G65.

label: New-gen G-Class shown
detail: Mercedes released first photos of the all-new 2019 G-Class (W463A) ahead of its Detroit debut, ending the old-body G550 after MY2018.

label: Used-car price peak
detail: Manheim used-vehicle value index peaked at 257.7 in Dec 2021-Jan 2022, then fell for about two years.

label: $90k 6k-mi 2017 G550
detail: Top in-scope standard G550 auction result found: a 6,000-mile 2017 G550 sold for $90,000 on Bring a Trailer.

label: Evora 400 revealed
detail: Lotus unveiled the Evora 400 (406 hp supercharged 3.5L V6) at the 2015 Geneva Motor Show.

label: US price $89,900
detail: Lotus set US pricing for the Evora 400 at $89,900; sold in the US as a 2017 model year car.

label: Evora GT replaces 400
detail: For model year 2020 Lotus introduced the 416 hp Evora GT for North America, succeeding the Evora 400.

label: Evora discontinued
detail: The Evora was discontinued after the 2021 model year and replaced by the Emira in spring 2022.

label: Used-car price peak
detail: US used-vehicle prices peaked in early 2022; the 2017 Evora 400 fetched $69,000 on Cars & Bids in Feb 2022.

label: $72K one-owner sale
detail: A 5,000-mile one-owner 2017 Evora 400 manual sold for $72,000 on Bring a Trailer, the highest 2017 Evora 400 auction result since 2022.

label: First C8 deliveries
detail: GM said first customer deliveries of the mid-engine 2020 Stingray would begin before the end of February 2020, with coupe production at Bowling Green starting around Feb 3.

label: Boom-era auction premium
detail: A 2020 Stingray 3LT (Lot T174) sold for $107,250 at Mecum Indy 2021, well above its ~$60K base MSRP.

label: Used-car price peak
detail: The Manheim Used Vehicle Value Index peaked at 257.7 in December 2021-January 2022.

label: Base MSRP up $10K
detail: Base Stingray 1LT coupe MSRP rose from $59,995 (2020) to $69,995 (2024), about 16.7%, which props up early-car values.

label: R8 V8 US launch
detail: Audi announced US pricing of $109,000 (6-speed manual; $118,000 with R tronic) with cars reaching dealers in fall 2007 as 2008 models.

label: R8 5.2 V10 reaches US
detail: The V10 R8 went on sale in the US from $146,000, shipping to dealers that week; the 4.2 V8 continued as the entry model.

label: Used-car price peak
detail: Manheim Used Vehicle Value Index peaked at 257.7 in Dec 2021-Jan 2022, the top of the pandemic used-car boom.

label: $145k V8 sale
detail: An 11k-mile 2009 R8 4.2 6-speed manual sold for $145,000 on Bring a Trailer, the top V8 result in this data set.

label: R35 North American launch
detail: GT-R deliveries began in North America on July 7, 2008, as a 2009 model.

label: 2011 facelift (530 PS)
detail: Updated GT-R rated at 530 PS (523 hp) went on sale in North America in February 2011.

label: Used-car price peak
detail: Manheim Used Vehicle Value Index peaked at 257.7 in Dec 2021-Jan 2022, the top of the pandemic used-car boom.

label: R35 production ends
detail: The final R35 GT-R rolled off the Tochigi line on August 26, 2025.

label: $107k low-mile 2009
detail: A 2k-mile 2009 GT-R Premium sold for $107,250 at Mecum Kissimmee, the high mark for 2009-2011 cars in this data.

label: US hatchback launch
detail: The all-new 10th-gen Civic Hatchback arrived at US dealers for the 2017 model year, starting at $19,700 MSRP for the LX 6-speed manual; it was the first Civic hatchback sold in the US since the 7th generation.

label: 2019 model year refresh
detail: Honda announced a refreshed front/rear fascia, new Display Audio with physical volume knob, and standard Honda Sensing across the Civic lineup for 2019; the Sport trim (already offered on the hatchback) and safety updates carried across all Civic body styles.

label: 2021-22 used-car price peak
detail: Used vehicle prices, including compact cars like the Civic hatchback, hit record highs industry-wide in late 2021 into 2022 amid new-car inventory shortages.

label: End of 10th-gen hatchback production
detail: The redesigned 11th-generation Civic Hatchback went on sale September 21, 2021 starting at $22,900, ending retail availability of the 2017-2021 10th-gen hatchback body style.
